findings.title: Action picker silently drops failed initial data delivery
findings.reproduction: Run ci-bin/lua probes/receipts.lua SOURCE_ROOT. Open the production ui.action_picker through its public API, retain the actual pool route, make the native evaluateJavaScript boundary throw, and deliver a correctly named ready message from the exact attached view. The exception is swallowed, no ERROR is recorded, and the view remains open. Repeat with hs.json.encode throwing: zero native delivery attempts, zero errors, view remains open. Healthy delivery and exact-source confirmation controls pass. This is a Linux Lua boundary replay, not a native Darwin/WebKit execution.
findings.root_cause: ui/action_picker/init.lua push_init protects encoding and evaluateJavaScript with pcall but ignores the failure values and never reports a failure. It also provides no completion observer. Its ready and didFinishNavigation entries both use this same unchecked delivery.
findings.silent_failure: The inner pcall consumes the raised boundary exception before ControllerPool.dispatch can log it. Logger.info still says that the picker opened. The custom probe observes zero central error messages; native stderr and asynchronous WebKit default error logging were not measured.
findings.regression_test: Drive the production picker and pool with correct native name/source and force encoding exception and evaluation exception independently. Require a fixed-metadata ERROR or explicit failed/opening state, with private action data withheld; preserve healthy init, confirmation, foreign-source rejection and stale-session controls. Add completion handling qualified against adapters.webview_result nil and {code=0} success sentinels.

findings.title: Shortcut auto-close destroys the unsaved draft after a refused hotstring save
findings.reproduction: Enable close-on-add and open the personal hotstring editor through its registered native shortcut. The actual host initData carries open_mode=shortcut and auto_close=true. Add a unique trigger/output and click Save. The actual shared page sends save then independent close. Make an external private-file writer win at the native CAS publication boundary (or refuse the native write). The real macOS editor and real shared writer refuse publication, log two errors and issue one notification; the following close message still invokes delete. Reopen and deliver ready: the real host initData has no attempted draft. Replay probes/autoclose-host.lua SOURCE_ROOT NODE_CLI ARTIFACT_ROOT; it runs the complete production JS script and actual public macOS editor/parser/writer with only native ports modeled.
findings.root_cause: _shared/ui/hotstring_editor/script.js saveEntry(false) calls persist() then posts close whenever shortcut mode and autoClose are true, without a save acknowledgement. ui/hotstring_editor/init.lua handles save failure locally but retains no candidate or close veto, and its independent close action unconditionally calls M.close(). The draft exists only in the retiring page; a new page is initialized from disk.
findings.silent_failure: The refused publication is loud: central error logging and an error notification occur. They contain no attempted trigger/output and are not recovery storage. The subsequent automatic deletion and missing draft on reopen have no preservation or retry protocol. This finding is loss of the refused draft, not the optimistic Saved toast or absence of a diagnostic.
findings.regression_test: Drive the complete production JS saveEntry/persist/toLua with actual host-provided shortcut/auto_close values and route its generated messages into the real macOS public editor and real TOML writer. Refuse a real-file CAS and native write separately; require the draft to remain open/recoverable until an exact successful save acknowledgement or explicit user discard. Preserve healthy save+close/reopen persistence and refusal controls with auto-close disabled or menu mode. A loud error alone must not satisfy the preservation assertion.
